notes.subject: 2027 provider opportunity - Bingen Huckleberry Festival
notes.body: 2026 Huckleberry Festival is Sept. 11-13 at Daubenspeck Park in Bingen WA. Official site lists bingenhuckleberryfestival@gmail.com and 509-493-3607. The event already promotes children's activities and family entertainment, so use a respectful 2027 provider-introduction angle instead of trying to displace the current 2026 setup. Washington is weather-restricted, not on hold: prepaid should be pushed first. Old Farmer's Almanac currently calls for showers then sunny/cool Sept. 11-17 in the Pacific Northwest, reinforcing prepaid as the safer primary commercial angle. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found for this Bingen event. Sources verified Aug. 27, 2026: huckleberry-fest.com, bingenwashington.com, Old Farmer's Almanac.

followUps.label: 2027 provider intro follow-up
followUps.reason: After the 2027 introduction draft is sent, follow up with the Huckleberry Festival committee if they have not replied. Keep prepaid as the primary model because of Washington weather risk; pay-for-play remains possible by approval.
